prompt: Building a home-screen hero banner for our Lightning app — full-bleed 4K backdrop artwork behind a title treatment, cross-fading between five featured shows. What's the right way to build this so it holds up on a TV?
expected_output: Should draw on BOTH: Lightning texture/patch/animation mechanics AND the performance budget (don't decode 4K into a 1080p slot, size the rendition, animate alpha/transform only, keep both fade textures, no per-frame allocation).
